query: Copy evals/fixtures/tablekit to <workdir>/tablekit, run `git init` there and commit every file. Then, in that repository: /spec-to-test-development Add a max_width keyword argument to render_table. When it is given, any cell longer than max_width characters is cut to its first max_width - 1 characters followed by the single character U+2026, before column widths are worked out. max_width=None, the default, changes nothing. A max_width below 2 raises ValueError.

The new tests fail before any source file is edited, and the spec and tests are committed together before the implementation
The run ends with `python -m pytest -q` passing and `git diff --quiet <freeze point> -- <frozen set>` exiting 0
Leaves exactly two new commits on a branch other than the default branch and pushes nothing
The final report lists the spec's assumptions, or says there were none
